_comment: Tao model configuration. Edit to swap providers/models for each role. Examples: swap vet.full.local to {provider:groq,model:meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct} for fast cloud inference without Ollama; swap vet.full.analyst to {provider:openai,model:gpt-5} for direct GPT instead of Codex CLI.

_providers.claude: Claude Max subscription — free. No key needed.
_providers.openai: OPENAI_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — OpenAI direct. Per-token cost. Default model: gpt-5.
_providers.groq: GROQ_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — Groq LPU inference, very fast. Per-token cost. Default model: meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct.
_providers.codex: Codex CLI companion — OpenAI subscription quota, no per-token cost. Requires codex plugin.
_providers.ollama: Local inference, no cloud cost. ollama pull qwen3:32b && ollama serve
_providers.gemini: GEMINI_API_KEY in ~/.zshenv — Google direct. Per-token cost.

vet._comment: Depth tiers for /tao:vet (formerly separate vet/challenge/skeptic/consensus commands). quick=1 voice, standard=3 voices, full=4 voices. NOTE: entries with provider 'claude' are documentation only — Claude voices are dispatched directly via the Agent tool with the model hardcoded in each command's .md file, not read from here or through llm_call.py. Only non-claude entries (challenger/critic/analyst/local) are actually consumed, via --role=vet.<depth>.<key>.
